hook: Nobody mentions this about Muse in Instagram DMs
sentences: Instagram users can now chat with Meta's AI agent Muse in a DM thread.
You can ask Muse to add a coffee shop to an itinerary or find a shoe deal.
Muse also organizes saved posts into Collections and can turn a recipe video into a grocery list.
All of this happens without leaving Instagram, so you stay in the same app.
Because Muse lives in the DM, you can prompt it directly on the post you're looking at.
